description: A key made of several parts, such as `(tenant, event_id)`. A `tuple` keeps the parts and their positions and is hashable when the parts are.
How the data is read (by key, by position, in order, by membership). It decides the container before anything else.
`dict.fromkeys(items)` keeps the first arrival of each item; `set(items)` loses the order.
The plan's decisions agree with each other and with the briefing: keyed lookups at volume rule out a list, arrival order rules out set de-duplication.
Architecture Decision Record: context, decision, alternatives considered and consequences.
